description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVars, which provides a method to retrieve configuration variables from Smarty template data objects, traversing parent templates if needed.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVars
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve configuration variables from Smarty templates.

methods.name: getConfigVars
methods.description: Retrieves a single configuration variable or all configuration variables from Smarty template data, optionally searching parent templates.
